name: AniList
summary: Sleek modern anime, manga & doujinshi tracking database featuring a dedicated 18+ Adult content toggle, staff credits, and GraphQL API.
ranking_rationale: Cleanest modern UI & open GraphQL API for tracking both mainstream anime and 18+ OVA/H-manga libraries (trade-off: pure tracking & metadata community—zero streaming or downloads).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.
